organizer.name: ANNT
organizer.fullName: Asocijacija za napredak nauke i tehnologije
organizer.about: ANNT connects young scientists and experts in Bosnia and Herzegovina and abroad to advance science, technology, and education in BiH.

cards.title: Agent marketplace
cards.description: Find the agent form factor. Then ship agents people actually use.
deliverables: Define how people install an agent, talk to it, and help it improve through feedback.
List the agent offering in the App Store.
Ship two useful agents, including a reviewer agent.
cards.format: One open team per challenge. Prize split among contributors.

cards.title: Game studio
cards.description: One clean flow from an idea to a playable game.
deliverables: Generate textures, sprites, and sound, and bring them into the game.
Invite others to test what you make.
Prove the flow by shipping a small game made with the studio.
cards.format: One open team per challenge. Prize split among contributors.

cards.title: Multiplayer & shared worlds
cards.description: Bring people from different instances into the same world.
deliverables: Build a lobby people from different Möbius instances can join.
Ship two games that use it.
Create one shared space to explore together.
cards.format: One open team per challenge. Prize split among contributors.
cards.risk: Live multiplayer across instances probably needs a relay, so this flagship may be partly platform work.

cards.title: Immersive gallery
cards.description: A walkable 3D exhibition that feels intuitive on phone and desktop.
deliverables: Make navigation intuitive on both phone and desktop.
Bonus: host the hackathon’s art and memes, and become the closing-ceremony venue.

cards.title: Private pro desk
cards.description: A finance or science app with a background agent.
deliverables: Create a useful finance or science app with a background agent.
For example: a monthly money review from bank exports, or a paper watcher with a lab notebook.
Keep the data on the user’s own server.

cards.title: Möbius speaks
cards.description: Give the agent a voice, and let people interrupt it by voice.
deliverables: Narrate what the agent is doing while it works.
Let the user interrupt by voice.
Stretch goal: hands-free chat. This brief is platform work.

rules.title: The event
rules.text: 28 September – 9 October 2026. Organized by ANNT. Grow the App Store, build and test together in Social, and improve Möbius — apps and platform. Everything runs through Hackaton 2026.

rules.title: Team formats
rules.text: Flagship bounties: one open team per challenge, with the prize split among contributors. Open briefs: multiple entries allowed, one winner per brief.

rules.title: Eligibility & prize limits
items: Maximum two cash prizes per person.
The platform pool and Community MVP do not count toward the cap.
Only projects published in the App Store count.

rules.title: How the jury decides
items: Works well on phone and web.

rules.title: Platform contributions
rules.text: The 1,200 BAM platform pool is split by points for fixes and improvements merged into Möbius: small fix — 1 point; real bug or improvement — 3 points; security or data-loss — 5 points.

rules.title: Details still to come
rules.text: Jury names, exact submission cut-off times, and the contributor prize-splitting method have not been announced yet.
